notes: οἱ πολλοί splits under rule 22 (we who on the article, headed on the nominal we) with are many on the adjectival predicate under rule 53; no participle follows, so rule 32 is not in point.
καθ᾽ εἷς → severally is one noncompositional unit headed on the governed word (rule 45's own example), and the intervening τό stays its own unrepresented unit under rule 93.
ἀλλήλων → one of another heads on another under rule 83.
